blocks.text: Line graphs are used to show trends over time. They plot data points and connect them with a line, making it easy to observe changes.
Example: If you track the temperature over a week, a line graph will show how the temperature rises and falls each day.

blocks.alt: Line graph titled Temperature, degrees C, from 10 am to 8 pm: -5 at 10 am, 1 at 12 pm, 2 at 2 pm, -3 at 4 pm, -5 at 6 pm and -9 at 8 pm, on a scale from -10 to 4.
